label: Coordinates
role: To position and frame each Factor’s knot inside S³, transforming the Factor Library into an ocean of interacting strands.
definition: Coordinates is an element of the configuration space C = SO(4) × ℤ. The SO(4) component (represented as a pair of unit quaternions (u,v) modulo sign) places the canonical T(19,2) knot K₀ at a specific location and orientation in S³. The integer ℤ is the framing number (0 = orientable ribbon, 1 = non‑orientable Möbius band). Two Factors A,B thus have a relative rotation R_AB = R_B⁻¹ R_A, from which we compute their Gauss linking number and braiding. This coordinate system turns the Factor Library from a point cloud on S² into the full ocean of framed strands on S³ you envisioned — each strand a uroboros when framing is non‑trivial.
manifestation: Factor A has placement=(u:0.707+0.707i, v:1), framing=0; Factor B has placement=(u:1, v:0.5+0.866i), framing=1. Their relative linking Lk = 2, driving strong narrative interaction. A framing of 1 means one cycle around the knot returns with a half‑twist — the story ends mirrored, ready for the next turn.

so4.description: Two unit quaternions (u,v) ∈ S³ × S³ / {±1}, acting on S³ by x ↦ u x v⁻¹.

framing.description: Twist number of the ribbon framing. 0 = orientable cylinder (knot view), 1 = non‑orientable Möbius band (uroboros).

effect_on_phase_closure: For framing τ, the phase closure condition becomes ∮ dθ = τπ mod 2π. τ=0 ⇒ full closure; τ=1 ⇒ mirrored return.
